CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_logs" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entity_id" uuid,
  "entity_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "tenant_id" uuid,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."categories" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."customers" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."expense_categories" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."expenses" (
  "amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "category_id" uuid,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_by" uuid NOT NULL,
  "expense_date" date NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."products" (
  "attributes" jsonb,
  "brand" text,
  "category_id" uuid,
  "color_id" uuid,
  "cost_price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiry_date" date,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text,
  "is_deleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sell_price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "size_id" uuid,
  "sku" text NOT NULL,
  "stock_qty" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "unit_id" uuid,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "weight_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."returns" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_by" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  "refund_amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "sale_item_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sale_items" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "product_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sale_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "unit_cost" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "unit_price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sales" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customer_id" uuid,
  "discount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invoice_no" text NOT NULL,
  "paid_amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "payment_method" text,
  "sold_by" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'completed' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "total_amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "vat_amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "sales_status_check_f3fa80dd" CHECK ("status" IN ('draft', 'completed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."stock_movements" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_by" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "product_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "supplier_id" uuid,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "unit_cost" numeric(10,2),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "stock_movements_type_check_21048d23" CHECK ("type" IN ('in', 'out', 'adjustment', 'return', 'wastage'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."subscriptions" (
  "amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "ends_at" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "plan" text NOT NULL,
  "started_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "stripe_customer_id" text,
  "stripe_subscription_id" text,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "subscriptions_plan_check_4446931f" CHECK ("plan" IN ('trial', 'basic', 'pro')),
  CONSTRAINT "subscriptions_status_check_ce1e5d80" CHECK ("status" IN ('trial', 'active', 'past_due', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."supplier_payments" (
  "amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_by" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "payment_date" date NOT NULL,
  "supplier_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."suppliers" (
  "address" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tenants" (
  "address" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency_symbol" text DEFAULT 'BDT' NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invoice_type" text DEFAULT 'standard' NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "logo_url" text,
  "low_stock_threshold" int4 DEFAULT 10 NOT NULL,
  "max_products" int4 DEFAULT 100 NOT NULL,
  "max_staff" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "subscription_ends_at" timestamptz,
  "subscription_plan" text DEFAULT 'trial' NOT NULL,
  "subscription_status" text DEFAULT 'trial' NOT NULL,
  "trial_ends_at" timestamptz,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "vat_percentage" numeric(5,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "tenants_subscription_plan_check_37ed556f" CHECK ("subscription_plan" IN ('trial', 'basic', 'pro')),
  CONSTRAINT "tenants_subscription_status_check_5eb10fb3" CHECK ("subscription_status" IN ('trial', 'active', 'past_due', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "pin_hash" text,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_8541fdc3" CHECK ("role" IN ('super_admin', 'shop_owner', 'manager', 'staff'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."variant_colors" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."variant_sizes" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."variant_units" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."variant_weights" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."wastage" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_by" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "loss_amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "product_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  "tenant_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
